summary.name: Memphis Design. Supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicitly combines dots, zigzags, stripes, circles, and irregular geometry in bold contrasting colors. The headline must stay readable, and patterns establish rhythm. Inferred character: playful, graphic, pop-design energy.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly a good fit for UI and product storytelling, editorial and minimalist layouts, and motion posters with staged geometric compositions. Inferred fits include playful brand pieces, short social clips, logo stings, and onboarding accents.
summary.limitations: Explicitly limit simultaneous movement and avoid rapid full-frame flashing. Adapt or omit recomposition that obscures meaning. Keep the headline legible and never deform headline text. The suggested palette yields to any approved colors.
summary.palette: Suggested, not canonical: background #FFF6E8, foreground #202039, accents #ED718E, #3DBAB1, and #F4C64F. Five base colors, with no gradient enabled. Foreground on background measures 14.769:1, and foreground on accents ranges from 5.541:1 to 9.824:1. Verify composited frames. Approved colors override these and must not be recolored.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicitly stagger selected movements and elastic accents rather than animating every pattern at once. Alternate shapes and hand off patterns between cuts. Video state derives from seekable composition time. Scroll or hover interaction is optional and must not be required for export.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style. Audio should be proposed from topic, audience, and motion, honoring explicit requirements first. Options include music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence, with no fixed genre or tempo. Verify speech intelligibility, balance, and absence of clipping.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicitly build SVG patterns and reusable shape groups, load fonts and assets before rendering, and cache stateful simulations. Use only task-provided or authorized audio. Flattened tldraw exports lose editable shapes. Missing assets must be stated, not invented.
summary.combinations: Explicitly suggested: style-115 for speech-synced emphasis captions with #202039 outlines, avoiding faces and subtitles. Also style-106 for elastic squash and stretch on a few hero shapes, never on headline text. Memphis alone suits playful brand pieces.
summary.productionApproach: SVG is the style renderer. GSAP is the primary paused, seekable motion engine. Motion or mo.js are optional and require verified deterministic seeking. HyperFrames handles assembly and export; Remotion is used only under a documented fallback with the reason recorded. Inspect key frames and watch the full decoded video.
